text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After being out with Vodka…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What? You're going home already? Isn't it a little early?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is when kids go home—not us. Why don't we make one more stop before headin' back?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I know the perfect place, y'see. It'll be like going out for a drive!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Don't get caught up in the details! Just follow me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, without asking where we're going, I follow Vodka…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's see here… I'm pretty sure we go straight… and then turn right…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wow! The wind feels so good! Bein' out in nature is the best.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Right? The wind really is different than in the city. It's not half bad!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Now, which way was it again? And were there always this many plants around here?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Not in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: L-leave it to me. You just enjoy lookin' at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm a little bit worried, but I continue to follow Vodka. Until…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Where are we?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So we really are lost.
choice_data_list: Where were you trying to go?
Where were you trying to go?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …This really cool rocky area I found when I was wandering around here before.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I thought we would get there if we just took the same path as last time, but…
choice_data_list: Do you want me to look it up on my phone?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No way! That's like admitting defeat!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aughhh! Why aren't we there yet?! Is my memory goin' bad?!
choice_data_list: Let's just throw in the towel for today!
Time to awaken your sixth sense!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you're too quick to give up… But you're probably right. There's no guarantee we'll get there if we keep goin' this way.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Damn it. Let's go back.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm seriously so sorry, Trainer! I just wasted your time.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her I had plenty of fun just walking around and talking with her.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I had fun…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But, I really wanted to be cool and show ya around, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It really is such a nice rocky area. I wanted to talk with you there…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aughhh, I'm so bummed! Lemme try again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm holdin' you to that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka and I return to the way we came. On the way back, we have fun losing ourselves in conversation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sixth…sense?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Whoaaa! What's that?! It sounds so cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right. Just leave it to me! Awaken, my sixth sense!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Graaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! I just saw… some huge ruins nearby?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You got it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Graaah! GRAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Vodka's concentrating on that, I search for nearby ruins on my map app, and find a likely rocky place nearby. Now, all I have to do is…
choice_data_list: Thou shalt turn right in 200 meters…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Did I just hear… a voice in my head?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Holy cow! We can't stop now! Follow me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With an excited Vodka leading the way, we continue down the path until..

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! We really made iiit!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is insane, Trainer! I seriously might've just had a psychic awakening!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Ahahaha! I am the Great and Powerful Vodka, the awakened Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow Vodka's enthusiastic lead and the two of us hang out and chat in the rocky area for a bit.
